title: Directional Optimal Sub-Gamma Scales for Infinitely Divisible Laws
summary: Fixing the quadratic proxy in a sub-gamma bound at the true variance leaves a scale to optimize, and a two-sided infinitely divisible law generally requires different scales in the two directions. For a centered law with finite nonzero variance, we normalize its Kolmogorov canonical measure and multiply the resulting variable by an independent Beta(1,2) variable. The signed remainder obtained in this way gives exact variational formulas for the right and left scales.
